summary.text: Kerryl Clement is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 96, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
Clement also ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost narrowly.

paragraphs.text: Clement won the June 2024 Republican primary for District 96 over Joseph Velozo, 307 votes (57.1 percent) to 231 (42.9 percent).
In the November 5, 2024 general election he lost to incumbent Democrat Michel Lajoie, 2,517 votes (49.6 percent) to 2,556 (50.4 percent).
Clement advanced unopposed from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary with 779 votes and faces Democrat Luke Jensen in the general election.
